When a PVID has been assigned to a VSI
i40e_put_mac_in_vlan arbitrarily modifies all filters
to have the same VLAN. This is obviously incorrect
because it could be modifying active filters without
putting them into the NEW state. The correct method
is to remove then re-add filters which is already done
in the code where we assign the PVID.
Fix this issue and a few other minor nits at the same
time. First
column2: when we have a PVID don't even bother

column1: looping and simply add the filter with the PVID immediately.
In the case of the loop
column2: we now can remove several checks.

column1: We also don't need to use i40e_find_filter first before
calling i40e_add_filter
does a lookup already.
Finally
column2: update the return semantics of this function so

column1: that on failure to add a filter it returns NULL
success
column2: it returns the last filter added. Otherwise

column1: we're just returning the last filter in the list. An
alternative fix might be to return 0 or an error code
but this is pretty invasive to every call site.
